description_compelling: A large-scale capital project — a port, a high-speed-rail line, a hydropower scheme, a Belt-and-Road corridor — exceeding one percent of GDP or creating cross-border economic linkage. FDI flows, debt-stock changes, government-effectiveness scores, and corruption indices map the political-economic ground. Recurrent in fast-growing emerging markets and in states with active strategic-partner financing.

trajectory_alignment.method: z-aggregated across the emitted positive cases (count in samples_used), aligned by lead-year, gaps linearly interpolated. Pre-§F walks emit head(5) positives; §F-onward emit the full corpus.
